author: Pulse, brief 013 witnesses, 2026-10-16
note: Proposed entries for contracts/rules/rulebook.json `values` (the same shape: v, unit, tag, src, reason). Keel adds them; Motive owns every number and may change any. Nothing here is in the rulebook yet. Every entry is [S]. Third pass 2026-10-16, written to Motive's rev 2 (motive-takedowns.md): where we overlap, MOTIVE'S ID WINS (suspicion-s 20, check-in-period-s 90, area-watch-step, area-watch-missions, cases-per-level, case-level-cap, missing-trail, response.levels S0-S4, search-stash-m, search-stash-s, wake-s, restrain-s). Removed from my second pass: the temperament graces and jumpy/kin modifiers (replaced by suspicion-s plus optional suspicion-*-pm), the missing-person watch-level values (replaced by Motive's area watch and cases), response-unseen-floor-s (a seen takedown nobody reports raises no Alert). Entries marked optional are switches that default to Motive's behaviour.
reuses: response-witness-s (as dispatch: a landed report puts the unit on the street this long after)

Motive's: suspicion-s, check-in-period-s, area-watch-step, area-watch-missions, cases-per-level, case-level-cap, missing-trail, response.levels, search-stash-m, search-stash-s, wake-s, restrain-s, kill-trail, ko-s, kill-s
reusesProposedElsewhere: guard-leash-cm (1500, in briefs/011/pulse-fight-ai.values.json, not yet in the rulebook): the door guard checks a scream or a body within this of his post

body-check-ticks.reason: a body is looked for every 5th tick (phase from the body's id): noticing is at most 0.5 s late, and the check is a fifth of the cost

body-check-s.reason: an Idealist who goes to a body stands 2 s beside it to learn whether it is dead or out; the same size as react-s

screen-m.reason: a body in a recess or behind a screen is seen only from within 4 m on a clear line: a passer at the recess mouth, not across the square; measured on the r016 cast it leaves the Handover's service lane quiet after the 5:30 chime (7 people against 38)

scream-look-s.reason: a hearer who turns to look walks toward the sound for at most 6 s (8 m at walking pace) or until they have a line within 13 m

scream-fear.reason: a witness of an act or carry with fear at least 2 (afraid) screams; fear 1 (uneasy) flees silently; fear is raised by pressure and threats (people.rules scales.fear), so a pressured Fearful person screams

terrified-fear.reason: fear 3 (terrified) never reports: they flee, and shout if it was an act

mercenary-report-alert.reason: a Mercenary keeps quiet until Alert 2 (search), when the city is awake and pays for words; after one reported incident a second body is far more likely to be reported

call-s.reason: a civilian at a door or call box dials, is answered by the desk, and speaks the place: 6 s

post-call-s.reason: staff with a radio or a post telephone call straight in: 3 s

robot-report-s.reason: a patrol robot with a body in its cone halts its sweep and rings the desk on its own set: a fixed 4 s (clockwork)

robot-plate-m.reason: a person within 2 m of the patrol robot can press its hailing plate: the robot is a report point when it is the nearest

camera-scan-s.reason: a person watches a bank of camera screens and reads each every 20 s (the investigators' question-s is the same size); a body in a live camera's cone is noticed at the next scan, phase from the camera's id; a looped camera shows nothing

report-reach-m.reason: R-REPORT: every walkable street cell within 40 m of a report point on the grid walk; on the Handover grid the three doors give 84% and seven boxes 100%

report-cap.reason: at most 4 reporters in transit are kept per body (the 4 earliest landings): bounds state and cost; the player still has to face a second reporter if the first is stopped

report-alert-down.reason: a report of a person lying (alive or unknown) is an inquiry; the nth reported incident takes the rulebook's alert.byIncident[n-1]

report-alert-dead.reason: a report of a dead body is a search: the response unit goes to the place

report-alert-carry.reason: a carry seen is Alert 2 on landing (Motive 2.3 table); a seen takedown is 3

report-alert-assault.reason: a woken victim's report is an inquiry: a knockout is never above Alert 1 (Motive 2.3, 3.2; Call 2)

search-s.reason: an unfounded report is followed by a search of the neighbourhood for 60 s, then the unit resumes; no seal starts

scene-hold-m.reason: after a body is confirmed the patrol or guard stands within 5 m, so moving the body is a carry in a watcher's cone

avoid-m.reason: a Fearful finder detours at least 8 m round a body

stagger-s.reason: a woken person staggers 4 s: stands, cannot call or run

stagger-pace-pm.reason: a staggering person moves at half pace

call-out-s.reason: ON (Motive 3.3): a stashed, unrestrained victim calls out every 10 s, heard within scream-m; a hearer may report a noise (Alert 1) and the verify opens the stash; hidden and restrained is silent

service-bin-period-s.reason: a sanitation round empties each bin once in 15 minutes, phase = Hash.Of(bin id) mod period; learnable by Watch; P(emptied in an 8.5 min mission) = 57%; in the mission only, never between missions (Motive 2.4, Call 9)

service-bin-dwell-s.reason: the round robot stands 20 s at a bin; a body inside is found when it opens it

free-s.reason: a finder unties a restrained victim in 3 s; the victim then reports at once

meet-m.reason: a person is at a meeting place within 6 m of its stand

expect-look-s.reason: inside Motive's suspicion-s: the waiter scans the place and Q's nearby stops for the first 10 s of the 20; a body in sight turns it into an ordinary find

expect-look-m.reason: how far a look reaches along Q's other routine stops

alarm-spread.reason: at most 3 of the raiser's ties' expected places join the destination list

robot-reach-m.reason: a robot takes a destination within 60 m of its origin; farther ones are for officers

robot-wire-s.reason: the desk radios a patrol robot: it breaks its sweep 4 s after a landing

check-s.reason: a unit checks the place 10 s on arrival (the same as Motive's search-stash-s)

dock-reach-m.reason: R-DOCK: every walkable cell within 40 m of a dock or post, so a profile's arrival times can be delivered

scream-m.reason: a scream or call-out is heard 20 m round with no line (Motive's aware victim screams and a hidden victim's call-out use it); wider than the 13 m witness range, narrower than the 30 m of gunfire; a hearer's look still needs a clear line within 13 m

tell-m.reason: a person at a phone can tell a tie who is indoors or within 20 m on the street (a shout)

verify-alert-down.reason: a living person confirmed where the report said stays at 1 (a knockout never exceeds 1, Call 2); dead is 2 (report-alert-dead)

suspicion-fearful-pm.reason: OPTIONAL temperament scale on Motive's suspicion-s (20 s): 500 would make a Fearful waiter suspicious at 10 s; default 1000 = flat, as Motive

launch-gap-s.reason: units leave a dock or post one at a time, so a swarm streams out and can be counted

robot-alarm-cm-s.reason: how fast robots converge on an alarm: the patrol's chase speed (85), so nothing changes; 120 or 150 is a second difficulty lever beside the level S

hero-block-dispatch-s.reason: OPTIONAL, off: per Hero step, +3 s dispatch (citizens block cars, GDD 05)

hero-block-speed-pm.reason: OPTIONAL, off: per Hero step, -100 per-mille on unit speed
